name: Sand Blast Past and Future Me Controller Unit

basic.name: Sand Blast
basic.description:
After 0.5 seconds, fire a missile that deals 305~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy hit. Deals 50% damage to Structures.

Casting Sand Blast leaves an Echo behind that mimics Chromie's Sand Blast and Basic Attack, dealing 40% damage. Maximum of 1 Echo active at a time.
